uploads/science/Scipad/Year 10 Book 2/Wo.searchText: FUELS AND CLIMATE CHANGE Fuels Fuels are substances that are burned in order to release energy. Humans use a range of fuels (oil, gas, petrol, diesel, wood, etc.), and these can be classified as either renewable or non-renewable. Renewable fuel resources can be replaced, and will not run out. Examples include: biofuels (e.g. vegetable oil used as fuel, ethanol and methanol (made from wood, human or animal waste, etc.), biodiesel or hydrogen gas.
